about_the_game:
Handyman Fantasy Digital Art Book is Here!

Thank you all for your love and support for Handyman Legend! This time, we’ve compiled various development materials, concept art, and promotional illustrations into this digital art book. Additionally, we’ve included some extra special artwork for you to enjoy! With over 42 pages—double the content of the previous book—we hope you’ll love it!

Please note that purchasing this art book is completely optional and will not affect your gameplay experience. If you'd like to support us, feel free to grab a copy!

Thank you all!

Sincerely,
Supashinken Team

※ The art book primarily contains images, with minimal Traditional Chinese text (the developers' native language), which does not affect the viewing experience.

※ How to open after purchase:

  • Right-click Handyman Fantasy in your library > Select Properties

  • Click Local Files > Browse

  • Open Handyman Fantasy Digital Art Book
